dishes.name: Brie de Melun
dishes.desc: A raw-milk Brie with a stronger, earthier flavour than most, protected since 1980 and made near Melun. Sold in Fontainebleau's cheese shops.

dishes.name: Brie de Meaux
dishes.desc: A soft, creamy raw-milk cheese from Seine-et-Marne, the department around Fontainebleau. Matured in local cheese shops.

dishes.name: Fontainebleau
dishes.desc: A light, unsweetened dessert of fromage blanc folded with whipped cream, served with strawberries or red fruit coulis.

dishes.name: Chasselas de Thomery
dishes.desc: Table grapes grown on trained walls in Thomery near Fontainebleau since the 18th century. Sold in season in autumn.
